checker.title: Check if your item can be returned
checker.description: Answer three quick questions. Nothing is sent or stored - the result appears here.
checker.daysLabel: 2. How long since you received it?

eligible.title: This item can be returned
eligible.description: Contact us within the return window with your order number and a short description of the item.

conditional.title: This may be returnable
conditional.description: Because the issue was reported late, our team will review the condition and proof of purchase before deciding.

notEligible.title: This item can’t be returned
notEligible.description: The item falls outside the policy below. If you think this is a mistake, contact us and we’ll take another look.

reasons.opened: Opened or used items can’t be returned unless they arrived damaged.
reasons.hygiene: Consumable and hygiene items can’t be returned once opened.
reasons.damagedLate: Damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Send your order number, the item, and the reason for the return.

pack.title: Pack the item
pack.description: Use the original packaging and include everything that came with it.

handoff.title: Hand it over
handoff.description: Bring it to the store or arrange a pickup with our team. We’ll inspect it and confirm the refund or exchange.

window.question: How long do I have to return an item?
window.answer: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

condition.question: What condition must the item be in?
condition.answer: Items must be unused, undamaged, and complete, with packaging, accessories, and receipts included.

damaged.question: What if the item arrived damaged?
damaged.answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos of the item and packaging. We’ll arrange a replacement, repair, or refund.

refund.question: How long do refunds take?
refund.answer: After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment method or as store credit. Cash refunds are handled at the store.

nonReturnable.title: Not returnable
nonReturnable.description: For health and safety reasons, some items can’t be returned once opened.

cta.title: Ready to start a return?
cta.description: Send us your order number and we’ll guide you through it.

trackOrder.question: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Open My Orders and enter the phone number you used at checkout. You’ll see each order’s status and totals. If you can’t find it, contact us with your order number.

cancelOrder.question: Can I cancel my order?
cancelOrder.answer: You can cancel before the order is out for delivery. Call us as soon as possible. Once the courier has it, the order may no longer be cancellable.

changeOrder.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
changeOrder.answer: Contact us quickly. We can usually adjust items before packing. After dispatch, changes may need to wait until delivery.

findOrderNumber.question: Where do I find my order number?
findOrderNumber.answer: The order number appears on the confirmation screen after checkout and in My Orders when you look up your phone number.

deliveryAreas.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
deliveryAreas.answer: The Delivery information page lists every area we currently cover, with its fee. If your area is missing, send us your address and we’ll confirm.

deliveryTime.question: How long does delivery take?
deliveryTime.answer: Timing depends on your area and order size. We confirm the expected window when your order is confirmed.

deliveryFee.question: How much does delivery cost?
deliveryFee.answer: Each delivery area has its own fee. You’ll see it in the delivery checker and again at checkout before you confirm.

missedDelivery.question: What happens if I miss the delivery?
missedDelivery.answer: The courier will call you. If a second visit is needed, an extra delivery fee may apply.

returnWindow.question: What is the return window?
returnWindow.answer: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

startReturn.question: How do I start a return or exchange?
startReturn.answer: Use the eligibility checker on the Returns & exchanges page, then contact us with your order number and reason. We’ll confirm the next step.

refundTime.question: When will I receive my refund?
refundTime.answer: After we inspect the returned item, refunds are issued to the original payment method or as store credit. Cash refunds are handled at the store.

damagedItem.question: My item arrived damaged. What should I do?
damagedItem.answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos of the item and packaging. We’ll arrange a replacement, repair, or refund.

stock.question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
stock.answer: The shop shows availability for each variant. If an item is unavailable, contact us and we’ll tell you when it’s expected.

authenticity.question: Are your products original?
authenticity.answer: Yes. We source products from trusted suppliers and only sell items we would use ourselves.

variants.question: How do I choose the right variant?
variants.answer: Open the product, choose the color or size option, then add it to your order. If you’re unsure, message us the item name and we’ll help.

warranty.question: Do products come with a warranty?
warranty.answer: Electronic items may include a manufacturer warranty. Keep your receipt and contact us if a product stops working as expected.
